design.motif: A game explorer's well-made field-journal cover: tightly woven cotton canvas, shallow folded map creases, a few stitched pocket-edge impressions and one small quiet terracotta registration tab. Material surface only; no characters, animals, game logos, Poké Balls, readable maps or text.

description.en: Tightly woven cotton canvas, shallow folded map creases, a few stitched pocket-edge impressions and one small quiet terracotta registration tab.
description.zh: 细密棉帆布上的折图压痕与口袋缝线，呼应随身收藏和探索；不生成角色或游戏商标。

design.rationale: The existing object, character or historical mark remains unchanged. Only a supporting working surface is interpreted from the product's purpose; no replacement Logo is generated.

description.en: GB / GBC / GBA collection with browser play and local saves
description.zh: GB / GBC / GBA 游戏收藏盘，支持浏览器游玩与本地存档。

purpose.en: Play user-supplied GB, GBC, and GBA Pokémon cartridges in a browser collection while keeping controls and progress for each ROM.
purpose.zh: 在浏览器卡带收藏盘中游玩自备的 GB、GBC、GBA 宝可梦，管理操作设置和每枚 ROM 的进度。

rights: Owner-commissioned Azure OpenAI generated decoration under applicable provider terms. No third-party reference image or font was submitted. Existing Logo, font and product rights are unchanged. Do not describe raster output as handmade SVG or assert exclusive trademark rights.

contrast.method: WCAG relative luminance on every native RGBA pixel composited over actual Hexly normal/hover surfaces, before the left-edge mask. Text remains fully opaque.

publication: Export-time record. Upload receipts and the site release establish subsequent publication.
